sourcePdf.pageConvention: PDF 1-based page = printed page + 1; image filename uses the PDF page number.

scope: Remaining 21 CoS production scenes: source-backed static room-group plans, relative heights, stair/shaft registration, explicit scales, entrances and parent-child identities, external foundation/terrain/water/material intent. All 48 levels included.
outcome: Complete source/static comparison for the declared scope, with supported relationships, confirmed mismatches, authored adaptations, source conflicts and runtime candidates separated. This is not an all-map runtime pass or release approval.
method: Read relevant spatial OCR passages and actual local PDF map images; source content is available and was inspected.
Compared exact git-show baseline scenes and authoring generators, all level diagrams, link endpoints, room validity/bounds and atlas placement.
Used own-word relationship constraints; source art and evidence remain outside Git.
A no-dedicated-plan status for N5/N7/N8 reflects the source, not missing access. Their town plan and relevant narrative were inspected.
Static findings can remain while review coverage is complete. Renderer, movement and exhaustive door-state verification belong to the owner lane.

maps.name: Village of Barovia

levels.planComparison: Compared roads, all keyed sites, churchyard and parent-building groups; markers are not full building footprints.

relations.sourceRelationship: The village plan uses 40-ft squares. The church and cemetery are in the north, the burgomaster property is farther south, and the inn and shop flank the central street.
relations.baselineObservation: The traced road/building groups and keyed markers preserve these cardinal relationships. The generator uses 85 source-image pixels per 40 ft. Key-room rectangles are navigation markers, while separate objects supply building shapes; comparing a marker rectangle to a whole child scene is not a scale test.
relations.disposition: Read-only finding for the implementation owner; no fix or release approval is implied.

relations.sourceRelationship: This is an inhabited but decaying village with muddy streets, building yards and the churchyard; the local plan does not require an internal river crossing.
relations.baselineObservation: Road dirt, roofs, fences and graveyard material families are present. The regional road join and the enclosing terrain height cannot be certified by this source/CPU comparison. bookScaleFt=5 is a schema normalization, not evidence that the traced village is eight times too small.
relations.disposition: Read-only finding for the implementation owner; no fix or release approval is implied.
